result.summary: This PR fixes a bug where LevelDB iterators held by gettxoutsetinfo, scantxoutset, and dumptxoutset can outlive cs_main and then race with AssumeUTXO's ResizeCache() replacing the underlying CDBWrapper, causing a LevelDB abort. It introduces a shared_mutex-based CCoinsViewDB::m_db_mutex so cursors and full compaction take it shared while ResizeCache() takes it exclusively, and adds SharedMutex/SharedLock wrappers plus non-LIFO lock-stack tracking to sync.h/sync.cpp so this new shared locking is covered by DEBUG_LOCKORDER, applying the same wrappers to SignatureCache and its tests along the way. The series was substantially reworked twice based on reviewer feedback.
result.problem: Chainstate DB users that hold a live cursor after releasing cs_main (gettxoutsetinfo, scantxoutset, dumptxoutset) can be killed by a LevelDB abort if AssumeUTXO cache rebalancing resizes the DB concurrently, a real crash bug discovered during review of a merged AssumeUTXO PR (#35465).

andrewtoth's question about adding AssertLockHeld(::cs_main) to ResizeCache() was implemented in the final push.

result.card: This PR fixes a crash bug: LevelDB iterators held by gettxoutsetinfo, scantxoutset, and dumptxoutset can outlive cs_main and race with AssumeUTXO's ResizeCache() replacing the chainstate DB, causing a LevelDB abort, as reported during review of the merged #35465. It introduces a shared_mutex on CCoinsViewDB so cursors and compaction take it shared while resize takes it exclusive, and adds checked SharedMutex/SharedLock/READ_LOCK primitives to sync.h/sync.cpp (with non-LIFO lock tracking) so the new pattern gets DEBUG_LOCKORDER coverage, also migrating SignatureCache to the same wrappers. The series was substantially reworked twice in direct response to andrewtoth's design and lock-checking suggestions, with the last open question addressed in the final push; only a concept ACK from sedited has followed. No dependency blocks this PR, and it is a foundational fix for indexes correctness plus a reusable utils safety improvement.
